project_info.theme: Lixibox Sundate Energy summer gift-with-purchase campaign

main_subject.detail: Luxury summer poolside promotional poster featuring a woman in a white one-piece swimsuit and oversized translucent sunglasses leaning on the edge of a swimming pool, smiling toward camera, with a lineup of beauty products and lifestyle props arranged on the pool ledge in the foreground.
